fields.name: linkedinUrl
fields.title: LinkedIn URL
fields.description: The LinkedIn profile URL that was checked.

fields.name: profileId
fields.title: Profile ID
fields.description: The LinkedIn profile slug extracted from the URL.

fields.name: isOpenProfile
fields.title: Is Open Profile
fields.description: True if the member has Open Profile (free InMail) enabled.

fields.name: canSendFreeInMail
fields.title: Can Send Free InMail
fields.description: Whether you can send this person a free InMail message.

fields.name: fullName
fields.title: Full Name
fields.description: The member's full name as shown on their profile.

fields.name: statusCode
fields.title: Status Code
fields.description: HTTP status code returned when fetching the profile.

fields.name: error
fields.title: Error
fields.description: Error message if the check failed, otherwise null.

fields.name: checkedAt
fields.title: Checked At
fields.description: ISO timestamp of when the check was performed.
